name: Voxel World
description: A native 3D voxel world explorer with terrain, trees, and block building
longDescription: Explore a procedurally generated 3D world made of blocks. Fly around, place and remove blocks, and shape the landscape. Features dynamic terrain with trees, first-person touch controls, multiple block types, and atmospheric fog. Now built natively with OpenGL ES 3.0 for smooth 60 FPS performance.
author: maxnebula
